svg.title: Separate a visible action from an explanation
svg.desc: The observation is that someone looked away before answering. Possible explanations include recalling a detail, feeling uncomfortable, and many others. None is confirmed by the gesture. A useful next step is a neutral question about the actual issue, such as which booking confirmation arrived, rather than an accusation about honesty.

g.text: Possibilities, not answers supplied by the gesture.
Check the issue, not the gesture
Use the answer or agreed record to decide the next step.
